system.description: The voices of the dead reach you across the Shroud. Ghosts flock to you with messages for the living, and you can sense their presence in a room without any special power. You cannot normally see wraiths, but you always hear them and can bargain with them for favors or information, though the Restless Dead always want something in return.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
